name: Austil de Mon
summary: In Brill, Austil de Mon teaches newly risen Forsaken to fight for the Dark Lady. He trains warriors at Gallows' End Tavern.

sections.title: A Veteran in Gallows' End
sections.body: In Brill, Austil de Mon trains Forsaken warriors at Gallows' End Tavern. Those leaving Deathknell find him among their first instructors. The living once drank and rested in the inn. Now Austil teaches the newly liberated undead martial discipline and combat against the foes surrounding the kingdom.

faq.answer: Austil de Mon trains Forsaken warriors in Brill, Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Where can I find Austil de Mon?
faq.answer: You can find Austil de Mon in Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, Tirisfal Glades, just north of the Undercity.

faq.q: What role does he play in Brill?
faq.answer: Austil teaches novice warriors fighting techniques, stances, and martial abilities. His training strengthens the Forsaken military against local threats.

angles.text: As a Forsaken warrior leaving Deathknell, you can seek Austil de Mon as a mentor for guidance and formal ability training in Tirisfal Glades.
As newly risen undead, you can train with Austil de Mon to become a frontline fighter ready to defend Lordaeron against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.
